ideas.title: Minnesota Nonprofit Leaders Accused of $6.5 Million Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate allegations of fraud against Minnesota nonprofit leaders, including Feeding Our Future and Robert P. Rubicco's daycare
ideas.angle: Follow the money: tracing the flow of funds from nonprofits to personal accounts
questions: How did the alleged fraud occur?
What were the nonprofit funds used for?
ideas.insight: This story could expose a larger pattern of nonprofit fraud in Minnesota and potentially lead to further investigations and accountability.
